title: DCGAN Throughput Benchmark: 64x64 Wide Channels (B=16, W=128)
intuition: Doubles DCGAN channel width (W=128 at 64x64 RGB) to expose parameter-dimension O(W^3) optimizer bottlenecks (such as full SVD/eigh or high-iteration polar updates on wide Conv2d weight tensors).
failure_mode: Matrix-conditioning optimizers with cubic parameter cost slow down sharply when channel width doubles.
protocol_notes: Research diagnostic throughput workload only; no image-quality gate.
